title: TipsPaidResult
description: tips.paid-result@1: the answer of the paid requests on OpenVibe.Tips (tips.checkout.create, tips.superchat.create, tips.tts.request, tips.media_request.create). POST /api/v1/checkout, /paid-messages, /tts-requests and /media-requests → { interaction, checkout_url, checkout_ref } (201; 200 for a replay of the same Idempotency-Key). Paid from credit, the interaction is settled at once, or still pending while Billing is retried. Through a checkout, it is pending and the supporter pays at checkout_url (https only; a PowerChat checkout may come as checkout_ref only); the paid message, TTS or media request exists only after Billing settles it. A service sees the interaction as a service (no subject for an anonymous supporter); a person as its supporter.
